title: Aspirin in Subclinical Coronary Artery Disease: A Pilot Randomised Controlled Trial
official: Aspirin in Subclinical Coronary Artery Disease: A Pilot Randomised Controlled Trial
summary: In patients with subclinical coronary artery disease, the ASCAD-P study aims to assess the feasibility of a larger phase 3 pragmatic randomized controlled trial comparing prescription versus no prescription of low-dose aspirin in routine clinical practice.

sites.f: Institut universitaire de cardiologie et de pneumologie de Québec (IUCPQ)
